body:
A design already approved before 0.39.0 was refused at implementation or validation for missing Worth questions. Read its current stage through the existing Spacedock reader and require the section while it is in ideation, or in backlog/unknown stage with a design. Preserve the unreadable-stage refusal and the existing rule for files without frontmatter.

Widen the observer's historical-schema exception to cover the same diagnostic when the event-time workflow did not require worth answers. Both compatibility decisions were approved at the ideation gate; the three-file scope is retained.

Validation:
- `python3 -B -m unittest test_design_surfaces`: 229 tests, 4 existing historical cases skipped; the new native-reader cases ran.
- Pinned replay: 173 tasks, exactly 10 later-stage tasks lose the Worth diagnostic; 17 ideation tasks remain refused; no other output changes or newly refused tasks. All three reported tasks match 0.38.1 output.
- Reverse-stage, never-require and dropped-reader-error mutations fail the new tests. Replay/path/title negative controls reject injected changes.
- Historical design-check paragraph replay at `d57ed9b75ba5`, with event-time workflow `04809c3c6146c9f4a8f2f0b916fe84c94bfaa1a3`: current-schema incompatibility under the new sentence; violation under the old sentence. This was a manual paragraph replay, not a full independent Observer run.
- Repository skill lint, ADR lint, number guards and comment-ratio checks: see the implementation report and committed evidence.

FO still owns the product push, Draft PR creation, RoboRev, hosted CI and the full suite on the result of merging this candidate with current main before asking for merge. The CI design-test command precedes Spacedock installation, so the two native-reader tests explicitly skip when that binary is absent; they must run with the installed reader during merge-result validation. CI cost was not measured; no CI configuration changed.

RoboRev: run by FO because the Codex sandbox could not reach the local daemon: `clean on 78905b08d; evidence=roborev:1785`.
